confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Penang price levels, projected to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Food and café anchors are moderately confident; midrange_meal_2p and accommodation vary widely by venue, district and season. cocktail and wine_glass are set relative to the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Malaysian heritage tourism cities such as Melaka and Ipoh, with Kuala Lumpur as an upper reference, based on general knowledge of Malaysian tourist price levels. Drink prices reflect Malaysia's high alcohol taxes.
